title: UI-P4 Storefront productization dan customer journeys
businessRules: Storefront UI hanya mengubah information architecture dan customer journey; pricing, promo, stock reservation, fulfillment, payment, return, review, favorite, dan loyalty tetap melalui API existing.
Customer session dan order access token tetap security boundary backend; route/view visibility bukan authorization.
Human Stage-20 UAT tidak boleh dihasilkan automated simulation dan candidate verifier tetap fail-closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Reusable StorefrontShell tersedia dengan deep-link route home, catalog, product, cart, dan account.
Catalog mempunyai search, sort, product detail, stock visibility, add-to-cart, dan favorite.
Checkout, fulfillment, promo, payment selection, dan server-authoritative total tetap memakai flow/API existing.
Akun mempunyai login/register, contact verification, saved addresses, loyalty, order tracking, review, dan return.
testPlan: Inventory/payment invariant: checkout tetap mengirim item ke orders API untuk server-side stock reservation/pricing dan electronic payment tetap menunggu provider/backoffice confirmation.
GitHub Full System Simulation untuk build/browser/runtime/exact-artifact/Stage-20 automated.
rollbackPlan: Rollback commit UI-P4 mengembalikan storefront single-surface tanpa mengubah data/API.
monitoringPlan: Pantau Storefront Next build, deep-link route, account/order browser flow, checkout/payment, exact-artifact, dan Stage-20 di GitHub.
securityNotes: UI route bukan security boundary; customer-session, order-access-token, tenant/branch, dan server-side commerce validation tetap authoritative.
